description: This file defines structures, function prototypes, and macros for an audio mixer component, specifically for handling multiple audio streams and applying soft mixing with different configurations.

methods.name: LVC_Mixer_SetTarget
methods.description: Sets the target gain for the mixer stream.

methods.name: LVC_Mixer_GetTarget
methods.description: Retrieves the current target gain of the mixer stream.

methods.name: LVC_Mixer_GetCurrent
methods.description: Retrieves the current gain of the mixer stream.

methods.name: LVC_Mixer_Init
methods.description: Initializes the mixer stream with target and current gains.

methods.name: LVC_Mixer_SetTimeConstant
methods.description: Sets the time constant for gain changes based on sample rate and channels.

methods.name: LVC_Mixer_VarSlope_SetTimeConstant
methods.description: Sets a variable slope time constant for the mixer.

methods.name: LVC_MixSoft_1St_D16C31_SAT
methods.description: Performs soft mixing on a single stereo stream.

methods.name: LVC_MixInSoft_D16C31_SAT
methods.description: Performs soft mixing in-place on a single stream.

methods.name: LVC_MixSoft_2St_D16C31_SAT
methods.description: Performs soft mixing on two stereo streams.

methods.name: LVC_MixSoft_1St_2i_D16C31_SAT
methods.description: Applies different gains to left and right channels in stereo.
